question: How can FreeLoader rename and stamp a file on the NTFS boot volume before the kernel starts?
allowedInputs: boot/freeldr/freeldr/arch/i386/pc/pcdisk.c already issues Int 13h function 42h for a read. The matching write is function 43h, documented at https://wiki.osdev.org/ATA_in_x86_RealMode_(BIOS). The CHS write is function 03h beside the function 02h read in that same file.
drivers/filesystems/ntfs/ntfs.h defines FRH_IN_USE as 0x0001. drivers/filesystems/ntfs/btree.c aligns an index entry length up to 8 bytes.
Reported: a stage delete stayed armed while removed-0 already existed. After the pass wrote the file into a free slot, the manifest started with update-spent-1.
